method: Observed real local WebGL application through browser accessibility, screenshots and ordinary UI input; separate from the automated DOM release gate.

environment.renderer: ANGLE NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER Direct3D11

observations.result: Real city rendered; menu displayed 3.23.0. Exported frame conditions identify this exact model build.
Request rejected with visible conservative-headroom explanation; remained in DRIVE without maneuver thrust.

HUD reported completion in 3.98 s with 360.3 degrees rotation. Later settled at zero pitch/roll, about 0.6 m CG height, four-wheel support, DRIVE, automatic jets off and commanded/actual thrust 0/0 N.
City-to-laboratory transition rendered successfully. Holding W+E+1 for one second reached FLIGHT ASSIST, about 7 km/h, 3.1 m height and 59 degrees pitch. Returning to city restored its prior state.
Prepared 120 Wh / 100 bar session, accelerated and braked, then ended recording early through the UI. Result correctly said pilot-ended, not successful route completion. Summary saved and exported.

The recorded 235-step session completed replay. Research panel reported exact reproduction, zero endpoint position/velocity/attitude/angular velocity/gas/temperature/wheel errors, and no missing control comparisons. Return restored the pre-replay state and view.
Captured error-level log list was empty.

actualFrame.sourceIdentityNote: Local runtime build is verified. Original dist/deployment.json remains archived, so this pre-publication capture correctly reports deployment-build-mismatch and no publication commit. prepare-pages generates current root deployment metadata separately.

preliminaryBaselineScope: Before the final 3.23 build, delivered 3.22 was also driven, X-tested, and rendered at high quality with wet-night settings. Those observations informed the audit but do not certify final-build wet-night pixels.
limits: This is an observed workflow report, not an automated assertion log or standardized route benchmark.
The finite-resource drive was intentionally ended early; it does not claim a complete challenge run.
Browser-generated combinations do not certify physical keyboard rollover or gamepads.
No audio-perception acceptance, universal shadow-flicker acceptance or full-city performance certification.
Paused exported pixels and short HUD FPS readings are not moving-route performance evidence.
